mapper.select: SELECT v.id AS id, v.version_no AS versionNo, v.status AS status FROM lm_inspection_scheme_version v WHERE v.scheme_id = #{schemeId} AND v.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY v.create_time DESC, v.id DESC
SELECT * FROM lm_inspection_scheme_version WHERE scheme_id = #{schemeId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT r.id AS operateId, r.name AS name, r.code AS code, rv.id AS versionId, rv.version AS versionNo FROM lm_inspection_scheme_parameter isp INNER JOIN lm_inspect_method_operate_bind bind ON bind.record_id = isp.record_id INNER JOIN bm_operate_rule r ON r.id = bind.operate_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN bm_operate_rule_version rv ON rv.id = ( SELECT id FROM bm_operate_rule_version WHERE operate_id = r.id AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE isp.version_id = #{schemeVersionId} AND isp.record_id IS NOT NULL AND isp.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.id
